title: South Korea Wants to Raise Its Birthrate but Doesn’t Have Enough NICU Doctors
summary_full: South Korea, which has one of the world’s lowest fertility rates, is in the throes of a breakdown in emergency care. It is particularly acute for at-risk newborns.
